prior_raw_optional_expansion.algorithm: Authenticate old historical export chain. Expand each files[] entry export_path, sha256, bytes; allow only relative prior/raw/ paths with no traversal or symlink; copy_verified to the same relative path. Copy prior/raw/RECORD_INDEX.jsonl using RAW_EXPORT.record_index. Rerun export_prior after fresh parent audit, never copy old RAW_EXPORT.json to active target.

legacy_images_optional_expansion.algorithm: Authenticate receipt. Expand files[] path, sha256, bytes; allow only external/legacy_images/ destinations; coordinate external copy with revision_ops.

notes: Do not recurse-copy the old root, parents, prior or data wholesale.
PARENT_AUDIT binds old package hash; RAW_EXPORT binds PARENT_AUDIT hash; both must be regenerated.
Old absolute source paths in historical receipts remain original provenance.
Preparation equivalence is not protocol selection, native acceptance or scientific authorization.

copy_prior_history_receipts.basis: retained historical image audit and copy receipt; preserve old source_root; external panel freeze binds receipt object identity
